searchText: EL/zkVM identification also makes sense to me, it should also help to identify the exact versions if we find some prover crashes. I think in `ere-guests` we can maintain a json like: ```json { "release": { "ethrex-33695e2/zisk-v0.16.1": { "ere_version": "0.8.1", "elf_url": "https://github.com/eth-act/ere-guests/releases/download/v0.9.0/stateless-validator-ethrex-zisk.elf", "vk_url": "https://github.com/eth-act/ere-guests/releases/download/v0.9.0/stateless-validator-ethrex-zisk.vk" } } } ``` So in `ethereum-package` we can resolve the Ere version to use and the ELF/VK URL, given the proof type e.g. `ethrex-33695e2/zisk-v0.16.1`
